titles.romaji: Sore Ike! Anpanman: Black Nose to Mahou no Uta
titles.english: Anpanman: Blacknose and the Magical Song
titles.native: それいけ! アンパンマン ブラックノーズと魔法の歌

description:
Anpanman helps a young girl with a magical flute overcome the influence of a dark being, while also encouraging her to use her talent to spread joy.

(Source: Netflix)
